metadata.purpose: Pre-migration backup of BuzzieWorld catalog collections.

products.name: Creative Sticker Story Kit
products.description: A compact creative activity that lets children build little stories with colourful stickers, characters and simple scene-based prompts.
products.shortDescription: Create colourful stories with stickers, characters and imagination.

images.alt: BuzzieWorld Brains wipe and clean activity mats

products.name: Logo Blitz
products.description: A colourful logo guessing card game that encourages children and families to recognise familiar brands while developing memory, observation and recall.
products.shortDescription: A colourful logo guessing game for family fun and quick thinking.

products.name: Animal Link
products.description: A self-correcting animal matching game where children connect related animal pictures while exploring farm, sea and jungle themes.
products.shortDescription: A self-correcting animal matching game for little explorers.

products.name: Map Match Challenge
products.description: A matching challenge that helps children connect places with simple map clues, landmarks and visual cues while building memory and spatial awareness.
products.shortDescription: Match places, maps and landmarks in a playful geography challenge.

products.name: Brain Binder Activity Book
products.description: A reusable wipe-and-clean activity binder designed for children to practise thinking, matching, patterns, directions and early problem-solving through hands-on activities.
products.shortDescription: A reusable activity binder packed with playful brain-building challenges.

products.name: Buzzie Brains Activity Mats
products.description: Reusable wipe-and-clean activity mats filled with playful exercises that encourage matching, patterns, visual thinking and problem-solving.
products.shortDescription: Reusable wipe-and-clean brain activities for growing minds.

images.alt: BuzzieWorld Brains wipe and clean activity mats

products.name: Phonics Sound Safari
products.description: A playful early-reading activity that helps children connect letters with their sounds through animals, objects and simple visual challenges.
products.shortDescription: A playful first step into letters, sounds and early reading.

products.name: World Explorer Geography Cards
products.description: A visual geography card game introducing children to countries, landmarks, animals, foods and interesting places around the world.
products.shortDescription: Travel the world through colourful geography cards.

images.alt: BuzzieWorld Car Logo Blitz card game

products.name: Create Your Own Buzzie Binder
products.description: A customizable activity binder concept that can be personalised for a child's name, theme or special occasion.
products.shortDescription: A personalised activity binder made especially for your little explorer.

products.name: Car Logo Blitz
products.description: A family-friendly card game built around recognising popular car logos, encouraging observation, memory, quick thinking and friendly competition.
products.shortDescription: A fast-paced car logo guessing game for curious kids and families.

images.alt: BuzzieWorld Car Logo Blitz card game

products.name: Animal Trail
products.description: A simple identify-and-match animal trail game that encourages visual recognition, matching and early reasoning through playful animal challenges.
products.shortDescription: Identify, match and explore with a playful animal trail game.

products.name: Little Legends Mythology Cards
products.description: A story-led card set introducing children to memorable characters, creatures and stories from Indian mythology through simple facts and playful matching challenges.
products.shortDescription: Discover fascinating legends and characters through colourful cards.

products.name: Party Play Return Gift Pack
products.description: A cheerful compact activity pack designed for birthdays and celebrations, giving children a screen-free activity they can enjoy after the party.
products.shortDescription: A fun activity gift pack made for birthdays and celebrations.

products.name: Mythology Match Quest
products.description: A memory and matching game inspired by mythology themes, where children pair characters, symbols and story elements while strengthening recall and observation.
products.shortDescription: Match characters and symbols while discovering legendary stories.

products.name: Animal Homes Activity Kit
products.description: An animal-themed learning activity kit introducing children to animal homes, babies, sounds and food through colourful hands-on activities.
products.shortDescription: Explore animal homes, babies, sounds and food through playful activities.

products.name: Animal Homes Pocket Binder
products.description: A compact animal-themed pocket binder designed for children to explore habitats, animal babies, food and sounds through reusable learning activities.
products.shortDescription: A pocket-sized animal learning binder for curious little explorers.

products.name: Travel Quest Mini Game
products.description: A compact screen-free travel game designed for car rides, family outings and waiting time, combining quick challenges, observation and memory.
products.shortDescription: A compact screen-free game made for travel and family outings.

products.name: Word Builder Phonics Cards
products.description: A colourful card-based learning game that helps children recognise letter sounds, build simple words and practise early spelling through play.
products.shortDescription: Build simple words while practising letter sounds and spelling.
